10.1.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.1.text: The Bhagavat said, "O mighty-armed Arjuna! Listen to My best message once more, which I shall declare to you with good intention, for you are dear to Me."

10.1.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.1.text: The Lord said, "Further, O Arjuna, listen to My Supreme word. Desiring your good, I shall speak to you who loves Me."

10.1.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.1.text: The Blessed Lord said, O mighty-armed one, listen once more to My supreme utterance, which I, wishing for your welfare, shall speak to you who take delight in it.

10.1.author: Swami Sivananda
10.1.text: The Blessed Lord said, Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to my supreme word which I will declare to you, who are beloved, for your welfare.

10.1.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.1.text: "Lord Shri Krishna said: Now, O Prince! Listen to My supreme advice, which I give you for the sake of your welfare, for you are My beloved.

10.2.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.2.text: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great sages know My origin, for I am the first in every respect among the gods and great sages.

10.2.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.2.text: Neither the host of gods nor the great sages know My power; for I am indeed the source of the gods and the great sages.

10.2.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.2.text: Neither the gods nor the great sages know My majesty, for I am the source of them all in all respects.

10.2.author: Swami Sivananda
10.2.text: Neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know My origin; for I am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way.

10.2.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.2.text: Neither the professors of divinity nor the great ascetics know My origin, for I am the source from which they all originate.

10.3.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.3.text: Whoever knows Me as the unborn and beginningless Absolute Lord of the universe, that person, not deluded among mortals, is freed from all sins.

10.3.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.3.text: He who knows Me as unborn, without a beginning, and the great Lord of the worlds—he among mortals is undeluded and is released from all sin.

10.3.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.3.text: He who knows Me—the birthless, beginningless, and great Lord of the worlds—he, the undeluded one among mortals, becomes freed from all sins.

10.3.author: Swami Sivananda
10.3.text: He who knows Me as unborn and beginningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins.

10.3.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.3.text: He who knows Me as the unborn, without beginning, the Lord of the universe, he, stripped of his delusions, becomes free from all conceivable sins.

10.4.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.4.text: Intellect, knowledge, steadiness, patience, truth, control over sense-organs, tranquility of mind, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, and courage.

10.4.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.4.text: Intelligence, knowledge, non-delusion, forbearance, truth, restraint, self-control, pleasure, pain, exaltation, and depression, fear, and fearlessness;

10.4.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.4.text: Intelligence, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, control of the external organs, control of the internal organs, happiness, sorrow, birth, death, and fearlessness;

10.4.author: Swami Sivananda
10.4.text: Intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, existence or birth, non-existence or death, fear, and also fearlessness.

10.4.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.4.text: Intelligence, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calmness, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, and fearlessness;

10.5.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.5.text: [Also], non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, repute, and ill-repute—all these diverse dispositions of beings emanate from none other than Me.

10.5.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.5.text: Non-violence, reality, cheerfulness, austerity, beneficence, fame, and infamy—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone.

10.5.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.5.text: Non-injury, equanimity, satisfaction, austerity, charity, fame, and infamy—these different dispositions of beings spring from Me alone.

10.5.author: Swami Sivananda
10.5.text: Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and ill-fame—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone.

10.5.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.5.text: Harmlessness, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and failure—all these characteristics of beings spring from Me alone.

10.6.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.6.text: The ancient Seven Great Sages and also the Four Manus, from whom these creatures in this world are offspring—they have been born from My mental dispositions.

10.6.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.6.text: The seven great seers of yore, as well as the four Manus, all possessing My mental disposition, were born from My mind. All these creatures of the world are descended from them.

10.6.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.6.text: The seven great sages, as well as the four Manus of ancient days, from whom all these creatures in the world have descended, had their thoughts fixed on Me, and they were born from My mind.

10.6.author: Swami Sivananda
10.6.text: The seven great sages, the ancient four, and the Manus, possessing powers like Mine (due to their minds being fixed on Me), were born from My mind; from them, these creatures have been born in this world.

10.6.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.6.text: The seven Great Seers, the progenitors of mankind, the Ancient Four, and the Lawgivers were born of My will and come forth directly from Me. The race of mankind has sprung from them. (Mareechi, Atri, Angira, Pulah, Kratu, Pulastya, Vahishta; the Masters: Sanak, Sanandan, Sanatan, Sanatkumar.)

10.7.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.7.text: He who knows correctly this extensively manifesting power and My Yogic power—he is endowed with unwavering Yoga; there is no doubt about it.

10.7.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.7.text: He who truly knows this supreme manifestation and splendor of My auspicious attributes, becomes united with the unshakeable Yoga of Bhakti—there is no doubt of this.

10.7.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.7.text: One who knows truly this majesty and yoga of Mine, he becomes imbued with unwavering yoga. There is no doubt about it.

10.7.author: Swami Sivananda
10.7.text: He who truly knows these manifold manifestations of My Being and this Yoga-power of Mine, becomes established in unshakable Yoga; there is no doubt about it.

10.7.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.7.text: He who rightly understands My manifested glory and My creative power attains perfect peace without a doubt.

10.8.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.8.text: 'He is the source of all, and from Him all comes forth' - Thus viewing, the wise revere Me with devotion.

10.8.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.8.text: I am the origin of all; from me everything proceeds. Thinking thus, the wise worship me with all devotion (Bhava).

10.8.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.8.text: I am the origin of all; everything moves on due to Me. Realizing this, the wise ones, filled with fervor, adore Me.

10.8.author: Swami Sivananda
10.8.text: I am the source of all; from me everything evolves; Understanding this, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship me.

10.8.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.8.text: I am the source of all; from me everything flows. Therefore, the wise worship me with an unchanging devotion.

10.9.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.9.text: Having their minds fixed on Me, having their lives gone into Me, enlightening one another, and constantly talking about Me, they are pleased and delighted.

10.9.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.9.text: With their minds focused on Me, their pranas centered in Me, inspiring one another and always speaking of Me, they live in contentment and bliss at all times.

10.9.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.9.text: With their minds fixed on Me, dedicating their lives to Me, enlightening one another, and always speaking of Me, they derive satisfaction and rejoice.

10.9.author: Swami Sivananda
10.9.text: With their minds and lives wholly absorbed in Me, they enlighten each other and ever speak of Me, being satisfied and delighted.

10.9.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.9.text: With minds concentrated on Me, with lives absorbed in Me, and enlightening one another, they ever feel content and happy.

10.10.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.10.text: To these persons, who thus mingle with Me and revere Me with love, I grant the knowledge-Yoga by which they can reach Me.

10.10.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.10.text: To those who are ceaselessly united with Me and who worship Me with immense love, I lovingly grant that mental disposition (Buddhi-yoga) which leads them to Me.

10.10.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.10.text: To those who are ever devoted and worship Me with love, I grant the possession of wisdom that leads them to Me.

10.10.author: Swami Sivananda
10.10.text: To those who are ever steadfast, worshipping me with love, I give the yoga of discrimination, by which they come to me.

10.10.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.10.text: To those who are always devout and who worship Me with love, I give the power of discrimination that leads them to Me.

10.11.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.11.text: Out of compassion only towards these men, I, who remain as their very Self, destroy with the shining light of wisdom, their darkness born of ignorance.

10.11.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.11.text: Out of compassion for them alone, I, abiding in their mental activity as its object, dispel the darkness born of ignorance with the brilliant lamp of knowledge.

10.11.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.11.text: Out of compassion for them alone, I, residing in their hearts, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.

10.11.author: Swami Sivananda
10.11.text: Out of mere compassion for them, I, dwelling within their selves, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.

10.11.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.11.text: By My grace, I live in their hearts, and I dispel the darkness of ignorance with the shining light of wisdom.

10.12.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.12.text: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Abode, and the Supreme Purifier. All the seers, as well as the divine seer Narada, Asita Devala, and Vyasa, describe You as the Eternal Divine Soul, the Unborn, and the All-Manifesting First-God. You too have said this to me."

10.12.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.12.text: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, and the Supreme Sanctifier. All the seers proclaim You as the eternal, divine Person, the Primal Lord, the unborn, and all-pervading. So too do the divine sages Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa proclaim. You Yourself also proclaim this."

10.12.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.12.text: Arjuna said, "You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages, as well as the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', they are still named separately due to their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself indeed tell me this."

10.12.author: Swami Sivananda
10.12.text: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, eternal, divine Person, the primeval God, unborn, and omnipresent."

10.12.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.12.text: Arjuna asked: Thou art the Supreme Spirit, the Eternal Home, the Holiest of Holies, the Eternal Divine Self, the Primal God, the Unborn, and Omnipresent.

10.13.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.13.text: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Abode, and the Supreme Purifier. All the seers, as well as the divine seer Narada, Asita Devala, and Vyasa, describe You as the Eternal Divine Soul, the Unborn, and the All-Manifesting First-God. You too have said this to me."

10.13.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.13.text: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, and the Supreme Sanctifier. All the seers proclaim You as the eternal, divine Person, the Primal Lord, the unborn, and all-pervading. So too do the divine sages Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa proclaim. You Yourself also proclaim this."

10.13.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.13.text: Arjuna said, "You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme Light, the supreme Sanctifier. All the sages, as well as the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa [Although Narada and the other sages are already mentioned by the words 'all the sages', they are still named separately due to their eminence. Asita is the father of Devala.] call You the eternal divine Person, the Primal God, the Birthless, the Omnipresent; and You Yourself indeed tell me this."

10.13.author: Swami Sivananda
10.13.text: All the sages have thus declared Thee, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now Thou Thyself dost say so to me.

10.13.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.13.text: So have said the seers, the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and Thou Thyself also sayest it.

10.14.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.14.text: What You tell me, I take all to be true, O Kesava! For, O Bhagavat, neither the gods nor the great sages know Your manifestation.

10.14.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.14.text: I deem as true all that you have said to me, O Krishna. Truly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons know your manifestation.

10.14.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.14.text: O Kesava, I accept as true all that You have told me. Certainly, O Lord, neither the gods nor the demons can comprehend Your glory.

10.14.author: Swami Sivananda
10.14.text: I believe all that You have said to me to be true, O Krishna; indeed, O blessed Lord! Neither the gods nor the demons know Your manifestation (origin).

10.14.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.14.text: I believe in what You have said, my Lord! For neither the godly nor the godless comprehend Your manifestation.

10.15.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.15.text: Only yourself know yourself by yourself, O Supreme Purusha, Creator of all beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, Lord of the universe!

10.15.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.15.text: O Supreme Person, O Creator of beings, O Lord of beings, O God of gods, O Ruler of the universe, You Yourself know Yourself alone.

10.15.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.15.text: O Supreme Person, Creator of beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, Lord of the worlds, You alone know Yourself by Yourself.

10.15.author: Swami Sivananda
10.15.text: Verily, Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Supreme Person, O source and Lord of all beings, O God of gods, O ruler of the world!

10.15.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.15.text: You alone know Yourself, by the power of Your Self; You are the Supreme Spirit, the Source and Master of all being, the Lord of Lords, the Ruler of the Universe.

10.16.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.16.text: You alone are capable of fully declaring the auspicious manifesting powers of Yours, through which manifesting power You remain pervading these worlds.

10.16.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.16.text: You should tell Me without reserve Your divine manifestations where You abide, pervading all these worlds.

10.16.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.16.text: Be pleased to speak in full of Your own divine manifestations, through which You exist pervading these worlds.

10.16.author: Swami Sivananda
10.16.text: You should indeed tell, without reserve, of your divine glories by which you exist, pervading all these worlds. (No one else can do so.)

10.16.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.16.text: Please tell me about all of Your glorious manifestations, through which You pervade the world.

10.17.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.17.text: O Mighty Yogin! How should I know you, meditating on you? In what various forms, O Bhagavat, should I contemplate you?

10.17.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.17.text: How can I, Your devotee, know You by constantly meditating on You? And in what ways, O Lord, should I meditate on You?

10.17.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.17.text: O Yogi, how shall I know You by remaining ever-engaged in meditation? And through what objects, O Lord, should I meditate on You?

10.17.author: Swami Sivananda
10.17.text: How shall I, ever meditating, know you, O Yogin? In what aspects or things, O blessed Lord, should I think of you?

10.17.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.17.text: O Master! How can I, through constant meditation, come to know You? My Lord! What are Your various manifestations through which I can meditate on You?

10.18.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.18.text: In detail, please expound once again Your own Yogic power and the manifesting power. O Janardana! I don't feel contented in hearing Your nectar-like exposition.

10.18.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.18.text: Speak to me again in full, O Krishna, about Your attributes and glories. For I am not sated by hearing Your ambrosial words.

10.18.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.18.text: O Janardana, please narrate to me again in detail Your own yoga and divine manifestations. For, while hearing Your nectar-like words, I am not satiated.

10.18.author: Swami Sivananda
10.18.text: Tell me again in detail, O Krishna, of your yogic power and glory; for I am not satiated with what I have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech.

10.18.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.18.text: Tell me again, I pray, of Thy power and Thy glory in full; for I feel that I am never satisfied when I listen to Thy immortal words.

10.19.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.19.text: The Bhagavat said, "Yes, O best among the Kurus! I shall expound to you only the chief, auspicious manifesting powers of Mine, for there would be no end to My details."

10.19.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.19.text: The Lord said, "Indeed, I shall tell you, O Arjuna, My auspicious manifestations—those that are most prominent among them. There is no end to their extent."

10.19.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.19.text: The Blessed Lord said, O best of the Kurus, now, according to their importance, I shall describe to you My own glories, which are indeed divine. There is no end to My manifestations.

10.19.author: Swami Sivananda
10.19.text: The Blessed Lord said, "Very well! Now I will declare to you My divine glories in their prominence, O Arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description."

10.19.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.19.text: Lord Shri Krishna replied: So be it, My beloved friend! I will unfold to you some of the chief aspects of My glory. There is no end to its full extent.

10.20.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.20.text: O conqueror of sleep! I am the Soul residing in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the very end of all beings.

10.20.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.20.text: I am the Self, O Arjuna, dwelling in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.

10.20.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.20.text: O Gudakesa, I am the Self residing in the hearts of all beings, and I am the beginning, middle, and end of all beings.

10.20.author: Swami Sivananda
10.20.text: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.

10.20.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.20.text: O Arjuna! I am the Self, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the life, and the end of them all.

10.21.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.21.text: Of the sons of Aditi, I am Vishnu; of the luminaries, the radiant Sun; of the Maruts, I am Marici; of the stars, I am the Moon.

10.21.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.21.text: Of the Adityas, I am Vishnu; of luminous bodies, I am the radiant sun. Of the Maruts, I am Marici, and among the constellations, I am the moon.

10.21.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.21.text: Among the Adityas [viz Dhata, Mitra, Aryama, Rudra, Varuna, Surya, Bhaga, Vivasvan, Pusa, Savita, Tvasta, and Visnu.-Tr.], I am Visnu; among the luminaries, the radiant sun; among the (forty-nine) Maruts [The seven groups of Maruts are Avaha, Pravaha, Vivaha, Paravaha, Udvaha, Samvaha, and Parivaha.-Tr.], I am Marici; among the stars, I am the moon.

10.21.author: Swami Sivananda
10.21.text: Among the twelve Adityas, I am Vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; among the seven or forty-nine Maruts, I am Marichi; among stars, I am the moon.

10.21.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.21.text: Of all the creative powers, I am the Creator; of luminaries, the Sun; of winds, the Whirlwind; and of planets, the Moon.

10.22.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.22.text: Of the Vedas, I am the Samaveda; of the gods, I am Vasava (Indra); of the sense-organs, I am the mind; of the beings, I am the consciousness.

10.22.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.22.text: Of the Vedas, I am the Samaveda; of gods, I am Indra; of sense-organs, I am the mind; and of living beings, I am consciousness.

10.22.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.22.text: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Indra. Among the organs, I am the mind, and I am the intelligence in creatures.

10.22.author: Swami Sivananda
10.22.text: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Vasava; among the senses, I am the mind; and among living beings, I am intelligence.

10.22.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.22.text: Of the Vedas, I am the hymns; I am the electric force in the powers of nature; of the senses, I am the mind; and I am the intelligence in all that lives.

10.23.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.23.text: And of the Rudras, I am Sankara; of the Yaksas and the Raksas, I am the Lord of Wealth (Kubera); of the Vasus, I am the Fire-God; of the mountains, I am Meru.

10.23.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.23.text: Of the Rudras, I am Sankara. Of the Yaksas and Raksasas, I am the Lord of Wealth (Kubera). Of the Vasus, I am Agni; of the mountains, I am Meru.

10.23.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.23.text: Among the Rudras, I am Aja, Ekapada, Ahirbudhnya, Pinaki, Aparajita, Tryam-baka, Mahesvara, Vrsakapi, Sambhu, Harana, and Isvara; among the Yaksas and goblins, I am Kubera; among the Vasus, I am Fire; and among the mountains, I am Meru.

10.23.author: Swami Sivananda
10.23.text: And among the Rudras, I am Sankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, the Lord of Wealth (Kubera); among the Vasus, I am Pavaka (Fire); and among the seven mountains, I am Meru.

10.23.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.23.text: Among forces of vitality, I am the life; I am Mammon to the heathens and the godless; I am the energy in fire, earth, wind, sky, heaven, sun, moon, and planets; and among mountains, I am Mount Meru.

10.24.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.24.text: Of the royal priests, I am the chief, viz., Brhaspati (the priest of gods), O son of Prtha; you should know that. Of the army generals, I am Skanda [the War-god]; of the water reservoirs, I am the ocean.

10.24.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.24.text: Among family priests, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief Brhaspati; of generals, I am Skanda; of reservoirs of water, I am the ocean.

10.24.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.24.text: O son of Prtha, know me to be Brhaspati, the foremost among the priests of kings. Among commanders of armies, I am Skanda; among large expanses of water, I am the sea.

10.24.author: Swami Sivananda
10.24.text: And, among the household priests of kings, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among the army generals, I am Skanda; among lakes, I am the ocean.

10.24.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.24.text: Among the priests, know, O Arjuna, that I am the priest Brihaspati; of generals, I am Skanda, the Commander-in-Chief, and of waters, I am the Ocean.

10.25.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.25.text: Of the great seers, I am Bhrgu; of the words, I am the single-syllable (Om); of the sacrifices [performed with external objects], I am the sacrifice of muttered prayer; of the immovables, I am the Himalayan range.

10.25.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.25.text: Of the great seers, I am Bhrgu; of words, I am the single-lettered word Om; of sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of Japa; of immovable things, I am the Himalayas.

10.25.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.25.text: Among the great sages, I am Bhrgu; of words, I am the single syllable (Om). Among rituals, I am the ritual of Japa of the immovables, the Himalayas.

10.25.author: Swami Sivananda
10.25.text: Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among words, I am the one syllable (Om); among sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things, I am the Himalayas.

10.25.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.25.text: Of the great seers, I am Bhrigu; of words, I am Om; of offerings, I am the silent prayer; among things immovable, I am the Himalayas.

10.26.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.26.text: Of all trees, I am the Pipal tree; of the divine seers, Narada; of the Gandharvas, Citraratha; and of the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

10.26.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.26.text: Of trees I am the Asvattha; of celestial seers, I am Narada; of the Gandharvas, I am Citraratha; of the perfected, I am Kapila.

10.26.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.26.text: Among all trees, I am the Ashvattha tree, and among divine sages, Narada. Among the Gandharvas, I am Citraratha; among the perfected ones, I am the sage Kapila.

10.26.author: Swami Sivananda
10.26.text: Among all the trees, I am the Peepul; among the divine sages, I am Narada; among the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; among the perfected, I am the sage Kapila.

10.26.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.26.text: Of trees, I am the sacred fig tree; of divine seers, Narada; of heavenly singers, I am Chitraratha, their leader; and of sages, I am Kapila.

10.27.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.27.text: Of the horses, you should know Me to be the nectar-born Uccaihsravas (Indra's horse); of the best elephants, the Airavata (Indra's elephant); and of the men, their king.

10.27.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.27.text: Of horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, the nectar-born. Of lordly elephants, I am Airavata, and of men, I am the monarch.

10.27.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.27.text: Among horses, know Me to be Uccaihsravas, born from nectar; Airavata among the lordly elephants; and among men, the King of men. [Uccaihsravas and Airavata are respectively the divine horse and elephant of Indra.]

10.27.author: Swami Sivananda
10.27.text: Know Me as Ucchaisravas, born of nectar, among horses; Airavata among lordly elephants; and the king among men.

10.27.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.27.text: Know that among horses I am Pegasus, heaven-born; among the lordly elephants I am the white one, and I am the ruler among men.

10.28.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.28.text: Of the weapons, I am the Vajra of Indra; of the cows, I am the Wish-fulfilling Cow of the heavens; of the progenitors, I am Kandarpa (the god of love); of the serpents, I am Vasuki.

10.28.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.28.text: Of weapons, I am the Vajra (thunderbolt); of cows, I am Kamadhuk; I am Kandarpa, the cause of progeny; of serpents, I am Vasuki.

10.28.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.28.text: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows I am Kamadhenu. I am Kandarpa, the Progenitor, and among serpents I am Vasuki.

10.28.author: Swami Sivananda
10.28.text: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow called Kamadhenu; I am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents, I am Vasuki.

10.28.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.28.text: I am the thunderbolt among weapons; I am the Cow of Plenty among cows; I am Passion in those who procreate, and I am the Cobra among serpents.

10.29.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.29.text: Of the snakes, I am Ananta; of the water-beings, I am Varuna; of the manes, I am Aryaman; of the controllers, I am Yama (the Death-god).

10.29.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.29.text: Of snakes, I am Ananta; of aquatic beings, I am Varuna; of manes, I am Aryama; of subduers, I am Yama.

10.29.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.29.text: Among snakes, I am Ananta; among gods of the waters, Varuna; among the manes, Aryama; and among the maintainers of law and order, I am Yama (King of death).

10.29.author: Swami Sivananda
10.29.text: I am Ananta among the Nagas; I am Varuna among water-deities; Aryaman among the Manes; I am Yama among the governors.

10.29.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.29.text: I am the king-python among snakes, I am the aqueous principle among those that live in water, I am the father of fathers, and among rulers I am death.

10.30.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.30.text: No translation is available for this sloka.

10.30.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.30.text: Of Daityas, I am Prahlada; of reckoners, I am Death; of beasts, I am the lion; and of birds, I am Garuda, the son of Vinata.

10.30.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.30.text: Among demons, I am Prahlada, and among reckoners of time, I am Time. Among animals, I am the lion, and among birds, I am Garuda.

10.30.author: Swami Sivananda
10.30.text: And I am Prahlada among the demons, I am Time among reckoners, I am the lion among beasts, and Vainateya (Garuda) among birds.

10.30.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.30.text: And I am the devotee Prahlada among the heathens; of Time I am the Eternal Present; I am the Lion among beasts and the Eagle among birds.

10.31.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.31.text: Of the progeny of Diti, I am Prahlada; of the measuring ones, I am the shark; of rivers, I am the daughter of Jahnu—the Ganga.

10.31.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.31.text: Of moving things, I am the wind; of those who bear weapons, I am Rama; of fishers, I am Makara; and of rivers, I am the Ganga.

10.31.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.31.text: Of the purifiers, I am the air; among the wielders of weapons, I am Rama. Among fishes, I am the shark; among rivers, I am Ganga.

10.31.author: Swami Sivananda
10.31.text: Among the purifiers, I am the wind; among the warriors, I am Rama; among the fishes, I am the shark; among the streams, I am the Ganga.

10.31.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.31.text: I am the wind among purifiers, the king Rama among warriors; I am the crocodile among fishes, and I am the Ganges among rivers.

10.32.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.32.text: Of the creations, I am the beginning, the end, and the middle, O Arjuna! Of the sciences, I am the science of the Self; of arguers, I am the argument.

10.32.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.32.text: Of creatures, I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna. Of sciences, I am the science of the Self (of the individual and Universal Self). Of those who argue, I am the fair reasoning.

10.32.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.32.text: O Arjuna, of creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end; I am the knowledge of the Self among knowledge; of those who debate, I am vada.

10.32.author: Swami Sivananda
10.32.text: Among creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna; among the sciences, I am the science of the Self; and I am the logic among controversialists.

10.32.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.32.text: I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of creation; among sciences, I am the science of spirituality; I am the discussion among disputants.

10.33.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.33.text: Of the syllables, I am A; of the compounds, the Dvandva; none but Me is immortal Time; I am the dispenser of fruits of actions, facing on all sides.

10.33.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.33.text: Of letters, I am the alphabet 'A'; of compound words, I am the dvandva (copulative); I am myself imperishable time; I am the creator, facing all sides.

10.33.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.33.text: Of the letters, I am the letter A, and of the group of compound words, I am the compound called Dvandva. I am Myself the infinite time; I am the Dispenser with faces everywhere.

10.33.author: Swami Sivananda
10.33.text: Among the letters of the alphabet, I am the letter 'A' and the dual among compounds. I am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time; I am the dispenser of the fruits of actions, having faces in all directions.

10.33.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.33.text: Of letters, I am A; I am the copulative in compound words; I am inexhaustible Time; and I am the all-pervading Preserver.

10.34.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.34.text: I am the Death that carries away all and also the Birth of all that are to be born; of the wives of men, I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Wisdom, Constancy, and Patience.

10.34.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.34.text: I am also death, which snatches away all. I am the origin of all that will be born. Among women, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, endurance, and forgiveness.

10.34.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.34.text: And I am Death, the destroyer of all; and the bestower of prosperity to those destined to be prosperous. Of the feminine [Narinam may mean 'of the feminine qualities'. According to Sridhara Swami and S., the words fame etc. signify the goddesses of the respective qualities. According to M.S. these seven goddesses are the wives of the god Dharma.-Tr.] (I am) fame, beauty, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude, and forbearance.

10.34.author: Swami Sivananda
10.34.text: And I am the all-devouring Death, and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine qualities, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, firmness, and forgiveness.

10.34.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.34.text: I am all-devouring Death; I am the Origin of all that will happen; I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Constancy, and Forgiveness.

10.35.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.35.text: Likewise, of the modes of singing, I am the Brhatsaman; of the metres, I am the Gayatri; of the months, I am Margasirsa; of the seasons, I am the season abounding with flowers.

10.35.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.35.text: Of Saman hymns, I am the Brhatsaman; of meters, I am the Gayatri; of months, I am Margasira (Nov-Dec); and of seasons, I am the season of flowers.

10.35.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.35.text: I am also the Brhat-sama of the Sama-mantras; of the meters, Gayatri. Of the months, I am Marga-sirsa, and of the seasons, spring.

10.35.author: Swami Sivananda
10.35.text: Among the hymns, I am the Brihatsaman; among meters, I am Gayatri; among months, I am Margasirsha; among seasons, I am the flowery season.

10.35.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.35.text: Of hymns, I am Brihatsama; of meters, I am Gayatri; among months, I am Margasheersha (December); and I am Spring among seasons.

10.36.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.36.text: I am the destroyer of the fraudulent; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am the victory; I am the determination; I am the strength of the strong.

10.36.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.36.text: Of the fraudulent, I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am victory, I am effort; I am the magnanimity of the magnanimous.

10.36.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.36.text: Of the fraudulent, I am the gambling; I am the irresistible end of the mighty. I am excellence, I am effort, I am the sattva quality of those possessed of sattva.

10.36.author: Swami Sivananda
10.36.text: I am the gambling of the deceitful; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am the resolve of the resolute; I am the goodness of the good.

10.36.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.36.text: I am the gambler's cheat and the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am effort; and I am the purity of the pure.

10.37.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.37.text: Of the Vrsnis, I am the son of Vasudeva; of the sons of Pandu, I am Dhananjaya (Arjuna); of the sages, I am Vyasa; and of the seers, I am Usanas.

10.37.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.37.text: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; of sages, I am Vyasa; and of seers, I am Usana (Sukra).

10.37.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.37.text: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (Arjuna). Of the wise, I am Vyasa; of the omniscient, the omniscient Usanas.

10.37.author: Swami Sivananda
10.37.text: Among the Vrishnis, I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; among the sages, I am Vyasa; among the poets, I am Usanas, the poet.

10.37.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.37.text: I am Shri Krishna among the Vishnu-clan, Arjuna among the Pandavas, Vyasa among the saints, and Shukracharya among the sages.

10.38.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.38.text: I am the punishment of the punishers; I am the political wisdom of those seeking victory; I am also the silence of the secret ones; I am the knowledge of the knowers.

10.38.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.38.text: Of those who punish, I am the principle of punishment. Of those who seek victory, I am policy. Of secrets, I am also silence. And of the wise, I am wisdom.

10.38.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.38.text: Of the punishers, I am the rod; I am the righteous policy of those who desire to conquer. And of things secret, I am verily silence; I am the knowledge of the wise.

10.38.author: Swami Sivananda
10.38.text: Of those who punish, I am the scepter; among those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; and among secrets, I am silence; I am knowledge among knowers.

10.38.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.38.text: I am the scepter of rulers, the strategy of conquerors, the silence of mystery, and the wisdom of the wise.

10.39.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.39.text: Further, O Arjuna, I am the seed of all beings; there is no being, whether moving or non-moving, that can exist without Me.

10.39.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.39.text: I am also that which is the seed of all beings, O Arjuna. Nothing that moves or does not move exists without Me.

10.39.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.39.text: Moreover, O Arjuna, I am the seed of all beings. There is nothing, moving or non-moving, that can exist without Me.

10.39.author: Swami Sivananda
10.39.text: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, be it moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.

10.39.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.39.text: I am the seed of all beings, O Arjuna! No creature, moving or unmoving, can live without Me.

10.40.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.40.text: O scorcher of foes! There is no end to My extraordinary manifesting power. The above details of My manifesting power have been declared by Me only as examples.

10.40.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.40.text: There is no limit to My divine manifestations. Here, I have briefly described the extent of such manifestations.

10.40.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.40.text: O destroyer of enemies, there is no limit to My divine manifestations. This description of My manifestations, however, has been stated by Me as an illustration.

10.40.author: Swami Sivananda
10.40.text: There is no end to My divine glories, O Arjuna, but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glory.

10.40.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.40.text: O Arjuna! The aspects of My divine life are endless; I have mentioned only a few as an example.

10.41.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.41.text: Whatever being exists with manifesting power, beauty, and vigor, be sure that it is born only from a bit of My illumination.

10.41.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.41.text: Whatever being is possessed of power, or splendour, or energy, know that as coming from a fragment of My power.

10.41.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.41.text: Whatever object [all living beings] is verily endowed with majesty, possessed of prosperity, or is energetic, you know for certain each of them as having a part of My power as its source.

10.41.author: Swami Sivananda
10.41.text: Whatever being there is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to be a manifestation of a part of My splendor.

10.41.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.41.text: Whatever is glorious, excellent, beautiful, and mighty, be assured that it comes from a fragment of My splendor.

10.42.author: Dr. S. Sankaranarayan
10.42.text: Or, O Arjuna! Why this detailed explanation? I remain, pervading this entire universe with a single fraction of Myself.

10.42.author: Swami Adidevananda
10.42.text: But of what use is all this extensive knowledge to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this whole universe with only a fragment of My power.

10.42.author: Swami Gambirananda
10.42.text: Or, on the other hand, what is the need for you to know this extensively, O Arjuna? I remain sustaining this whole creation in a special way with a part of Myself.

10.42.author: Swami Sivananda
10.42.text: But, of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I exist, supporting this whole world with one part of Myself.

10.42.author: Shri Purohit Swami
10.42.text: But what is the use of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this universe with only a small part of Myself.
